liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds Jack Straw nice, but says the energy fades going into They Love Each Other; Reviewer singles out the opening Jack Straw as a strong performance [19][25]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 other source): A man behind the uploader kept chanting for Lazy Lightnin', and Bobby announced a song not played in a while [2]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 other source): U.S. Blues is listed as the encore, following Johnny B. Goode [1]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer calls China Cat very tight [23]

## Setlist highlights

- **Deep Elementary Blues**: rare: 12 archived performances [26]

## The recordings

- **gd82-04-14.sbd.braverman.7629.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 138 min; rated 3.94/5 by 36 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard is excellent, among the best-sounding board recordings from any year; Reviewer ranks the sound among the five best of 100–150 tapes copied in two weeks, possibly the best; Reviewer says Garcia's guitar is loud in the mix while the rest of the band is quieter [14][18][19]
- **gd1982-04-14.mtx.griesman.30206.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 140 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1982-04-14.155629.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 141 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1982-04-14.164799.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 142 min [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer hears the first set as sloppy, with Garcia stalling mid-solo and restarting several times [19]
- Reviewer grew up in Glens Falls and recalls bars across the street from the venue being dives [25]
- Uploader attended ticketless, stood against the stage, and says this show got them hooked on collecting tapes [2]
- Reviewer says the music lacks creativity and energy compared with 1968–72 shows, and calls 1977 the last consistent year [24]
- Reviewer calls this show and the August run of 1982 shows among the band's peaks, with Garcia's voice still good [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd82-04-14.sbd.braverman.7629.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer has long owned a soundboard tape of only the first set of this show [16]
- **gd1982-04-14.mtx.griesman.30206.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrix Mix by Randy Griesman; source: See info file [2]. Also: This is a matrix (MTX) version of a DTS mix created by the uploader [2]
- **gd1982-04-14.155629.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [3]. Also: A Nakamichi 700 source from Bob Wagner supplies a 29-second patch in Space [3]
- **gd1982-04-14.164799.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Audience Cassette; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1982-04-14 Wed Glens Falls Civic Center, Glen Falls, NY](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1256907274372/grateful-dead-1982-04-14-wed-glens-falls) [27]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1982-04-14 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1982-04-14-backstage-pass/) [28]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Glens Falls Civic Center - April 14, 1982](https://www.dead.net/show/april-14-1982-0) [29]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1982-04-14 Wed Glens Falls Civic Center, Glen Falls, NY](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1256907274372/grateful-dead-1982-04-14-wed-glens-falls) [30]
